title: Nonfire-resistance-rated assemblies.
officialText: Penetrations of nonfire-resistance-rated floor or floor/ceiling assemblies or the ceiling membrane of a nonfire-resistance-rated roof/ceiling assembly shall meet the requirements of Section 708 or shall comply with Sections 713.4.2.1 through 713.4.2.2.
